venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Nice day, got a little chillier towards the end of the night
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 3/19.** Smooth, slower-paced night; many one-and-done tables wanted to sit and chat. Good walk-ins drove revenue but the alley died down quickly after dinner. Natural last call with only 2 tables left; last guests out shortly after 1am. Kitchen: slow night for James, handled all tickets. MOD: Kevin.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 3/19.** Weird flipped Thursday with busy highs and lulls in between; unpredictable, leading to a waitlist but manageable. Used some of Thomas's go-to back catalogs; a group of 7 Australian singers stayed 4+ hours; camping tables made easy close. Comps $68.62 (1.2%). Door: decent Thursday, filled by 7:30 with 4 tops and solos; brief waitlists, small list of twos at 9pm done by 11:30; an Australian band on tour (two-top turned 7 top) celebrating their last night in the city; welcomed Melanie (FO Courtney) and a new neighbor; slowed 12:30. No-shows: Alex Wright 2 @ 6pm; Eric Klimowicz 2 @ 10pm (no info to charge). Kitchen: none. Repairs: electric lighters not charging.
